distractorCalculations.feedback: The constant 2 is added, so subtract 2 from both sides — do not add it.

workedSolution.ruleOrTheorem: Multiply every term inside the bracket by 3.

workedSolution.explanation: Collect the variable terms on one side (keeping a positive coefficient).
Collect the constants on the other side.
Divide by the coefficient of x.
Both sides are equal, confirming the solution.

distractorCalculations.misconception: Partial distribution over brackets
distractorCalculations.rationale: Multiplied only the first term inside the brackets by the factor.
distractorCalculations.feedback: Multiply every term inside the brackets by 3.

distractorCalculations.misconception: Wrong inverse operation on the constant
distractorCalculations.rationale: Used the wrong inverse operation on the constant term.
distractorCalculations.feedback: The constant 6 is added, so subtract 6 from both sides — do not add it.

distractorCalculations.misconception: Divides only one term
distractorCalculations.rationale: Divided only one term on the side, not every term.
distractorCalculations.feedback: Divide every term on that side by 2, not just one term.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Stops before dividing by the coefficient
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Isolated the variable term but did not divide by its coefficient.

example.studentFeedback: Divide both sides by 4 to find x, not just 4x.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Wrong inverse operation on the constant
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Used the wrong inverse operation on the constant term.

example.studentFeedback: The constant 3 is added, so subtract 3 from both sides — do not add it.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Wrong sign moving a variable term
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Moved the variable term to the other side without flipping its sign.

example.studentFeedback: Add 9x to both sides so the variable terms are collected on one side.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Wrong sign moving a constant
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Changed the sign of a constant without applying the operation to both sides.

example.studentFeedback: Apply the inverse of 3 to both sides and keep the sign of the constant consistent.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Combines unlike terms
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Combined an x-term and a constant into a single coefficient.

example.studentFeedback: x and 8 are unlike terms; an x-term and a constant cannot be combined.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Divides only one term
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Divided only one term on the side, not every term.

example.studentFeedback: Divide every term on that side by -9, not just one term.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Divides by the constant
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Divided by the constant term instead of the coefficient of x.

example.studentFeedback: Divide by the coefficient of x (1/3), not by the constant 4.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Ignores the constant
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Ignored the added or subtracted constant.

example.studentFeedback: Do not ignore the 3; apply its inverse to both sides.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Multiplies instead of dividing
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Multiplied by the coefficient instead of dividing by it.

example.studentFeedback: To undo multiplication by 4, divide both sides by 4.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Reverses the division
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Inverted the division: divided the coefficient by the value instead of the value by the coefficient.

example.studentFeedback: Divide -9 by 4. Do not reverse the numerator and denominator.

misconceptionCoverage.title: Partial distribution over brackets
misconceptionCoverage.observableError: Multiplied only the first term inside the brackets by the factor.

example.studentFeedback: Multiply every term inside the brackets by -6.
